name: io.github.msingatullin/mmw
title: MMW Managed Memory Workspace
description: Memory for AI agents you can trust: one memory across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and ChatGPT that flags contradicting facts and keeps the source of every fact.

remember.description: Save a fact or decision with its source; facts with the same key that disagree are flagged as a conflict

search.description: Search memories with provenance and stale/conflict status; the newest version of a fact comes first

validate_memory.description: Check the records of one source against its current hash and report stale and conflicting ones

forget.description: Soft-delete a memory or every memory of a source

gateway_call.description: Call project-scoped connected tools and external integrations
